claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (MMV/PSV/AutoFlow, PEEP 5, PSV 12, FiO2 30%) and monitor respiratory mechanics and gas exchange.
Continue insulin infusion at current rate and monitor blood glucose closely, adjusting to maintain target range.
Continue fentanyl infusion for analgesia and monitor sedation level (RASS) and respiratory status.
Continue dexmedetomidine infusion for sedation as ordered and monitor hemodynamics and sedation.
Continue vancomycin and meropenem as ordered and monitor for clinical response and signs of infection.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit; consider transfusion if hemoglobin falls below threshold or signs of inadequate oxygen delivery.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR, PT, PTT) and platelet count given elevated INR and recent heparin prophylaxis.
Monitor liver enzymes (AST, ALT, alkaline phosphatase, bilirubin) for trend.
Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium, phosphate) and replace as needed.
Perform daily sedation interruption and delirium assessment (CAM-ICU) to guide sedation management.
